## Highlights
### Improved
- Show the focused tab title in macOS window lists while keeping locked Spaces private - Find builds by release channel with clear publication dates and a separate download for every build
### Fixed
- Prevent the page loading bar from staying visible after in-page navigation - Switch Spaces without flashing blank pages on macOS - Unlock private Spaces comfortably at larger text sizes and keep loaded tabs in place when locking - Check for the newest build in your channel before downloading an update
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
